name: docs_list_publications
description: List Siemens documentation publications (up to 50): title, product, version, locale and reference. Use it to find valid product and version values for docs_search, or a publication to open with docs_get_toc. product (e.g. 'TIAPortal' for the Openness API, 'STEP 7', 'WinCC Unified') and version (e.g. 'V21') are matched against the catalog; call docs_list_publications to see valid values. Results use compact references by default; set reference_format='url' for reader URLs.

title_contains.description: Optional case-insensitive text the title must contain, e.g. 'Openness'.

product.description: Optional product filter, e.g. 'TIAPortal' (Openness API), 'STEP 7', 'WinCC Unified'.

host.description: Documentation host; default docs.tia.siemens.cloud. Other allowed host: docs.industrial-operations-x.siemens.cloud.

reference_format.description: 'compact' (default) for short references or 'url' for full reader URLs.
